paper_name: Global Fixed Priority Scheduling with Deferred Pre-emption
paper_description: Introduces gFPDS superset of gFPPS/gFPNS, with sufficient tests optimizing priority and FNR lengths, FNR-PA heuristic, outperforming both in experiments.

formal_description.statement: Global FP with deferred preemption: each task has FNR length L_i, 0 <= L_i <= C_i; preemption anywhere except FNR.
For fixed prio, optimal L_i maximize schedulability: solve LP min sum L_i s.t. R_j(L) <= D_j forall j.

informal_sketch.intuition: Longer L_i helps self, hurts hp.

formal_description.statement: FNR-PA heuristic: extend uniprocessor, assign prio and L iteratively.
